violations.why: ISR can preempt main between the read at 45 and the read at 51 (idlerun/before disable_isr at 47), changing var1.
After enable_isr(1) at line 50, the ISR can run during idlerun at 54 before the interrupt is disabled at 55, changing var1 between the reads.
ISR can run during idlerun at 46 (interrupt enabled); it sets condition3=0 so line 59 is reachable, and var1 changed between the reads.
